pages.name: Wade Defense
pages.notes: Overview and plans 2-3 described a pin on the f3-knight that the e2-pawn blocks; plan 3 played g4 onto the bishop; plan 4 named Black's Bxf3 inside a White plan. Rewrote overview and all four plans.

pages.name: Modern Defense: Randspringer Variation
pages.notes: Plan 4 routed ...Qe8-h5 with the king on e8 and the g6-pawn in the way; plan 1 relied on an f-file the f5-pawn still closes. Rewrote plans 1 and 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Modern: Averbakh, 4...e5 5.dxe5
pages.notes: Plan 1 named Black's ...Kxd8 inside a White plan and a vague Nf3-d4 manoeuvre. Rewrote both plans; British spelling.

pages.name: Modern: Averbakh, 4...e5 5.Nf3 Nd7
pages.notes: Plan 1 wrote the rook move as Rb1-b4 and pushed f2-f4 through the f3-knight; plan 3 predicted an isolated queen's pawn for White after ...exd4 Nxd4. Rewrote plans 1 and 3; British spelling.

pages.name: Modern: Averbakh, 4...e5 5.Nf3 Nd7 6.Be2 Ne7
pages.notes: Plan 1 rerouted the e7-knight to g8. Rewrote plan 1 (a first rewrite, ...Nc6, was rejected as unrecognised and replaced); British spelling.

pages.name: Modern: Averbakh, 4...Nd7
pages.notes: Plan 2 pushed f2-f4-f5 after Nf3, which blocks the f-pawn. Rewrote plan 2; British spelling.

pages.name: Modern: Averbakh, Queenswap
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed f4 after Nf3; plan 2 moved the king Ke7-c7 from d8 with the pawn on c7. Rewrote both plans.

pages.name: Benoni Defense: Old Benoni, Mujannah Formation
pages.notes: Plan 1 read e4 as a Black move and proposed an unconvincing ...g5 attack. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling.

pages.name: Old Benoni: 2.c3
pages.notes: Plan 1 offered Be2/d3 with the d-pawn on d4 and wrote castling as 0-0; plan 2 called ...d5 a Slav for Black. Rewrote both plans; British spelling.

pages.name: Old Benoni: 2.d5 e6 3.c4
pages.notes: Plan 1 combined Nf3 with f2-f4; plan 4 suggested Nb3, which no knight can reach usefully. Rewrote plans 1 and 4; British spelling.
